name: Homeless Guy
qaNote: Retry after upstream moderation failure; revised to a nonviolent athletic strength exhibition with one springy barbell prop. Reference inspected; preserve adult identity and beige outfit. Review barbell continuity, camera clarity, anatomy, cyan backing and title before acceptance.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated arcade-game super move, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Homeless Guy — Nothing to Lose.
IDENTITY: the exact adult athlete in the reference: muscular build, dark skin, long black locs, short beard, asymmetrical weathered beige shirt, beige trousers, brown belt and dark brown shoes. Preserve his recognizable outfit and illustrated face. This is a playful, nonviolent superhuman strength exhibition with a training prop; there are no opponents and nobody is harmed.
0–1.2s: establish full body. He turns two empty pockets out, smiles confidently, and reaches for a floating iron exercise barbell. At first the close perspective makes it appear ordinary. He grabs the middle of the bar with both hands.
1.2–3.2s: camera pulls way back to reveal the impossible scale: the same bar stretches across thirty feet of cyan, with two gigantic stacks of charcoal weight discs at its ends. His complete body is small at its center. He curls the enormous weight up, then bends the springy metal bar into a huge U above his head; the weight stacks nearly meet. Show the same connected prop bending continuously, with exaggerated comic elasticity. A few isolated amber tension arcs terminate on cyan. No gym, floor or environmental backdrop.
3.2–4.8s: he lets the bar spring straight with one spectacular SNAP, riding its rebound into a high somersault as the entire intact barbell spins end over end into the cyan distance. Camera whips alongside the enormous spinning discs, then racks back to his floating full figure. One bounded warm-white/gold star marks the elastic release, with a brief forceful hold and a huge resonant metal BWONG; no screen-covering flash or breaking objects.
4.8–6s: the barbell swings back through a wide arc. He catches it cleanly at its center with ONE HAND, stops its enormous momentum, then compresses the springy bar into a tiny neat coil between his palms. Snap toward his confident face as exact title NOTHING TO LOSE slams below it. Preserve clear, controlled anatomy throughout the catch.
6–8s: return to full-body hero pose. He pockets the tiny coiled exercise bar with a satisfied nod. One pocket gives a single little springy bounce, then settles. Stable face, outfit and title. SFX: cloth rustle, immense weight creak, accelerating elastic strain, dominant resonant BWONG, spinning air rush, deep clean catch THUMP, title slam, tiny final spring boing. No dialogue or music.
